question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.
sql:
-- Final query with proper casting
WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_date_range AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date::DATE) as min_date, MAX(txn_date::DATE) as max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT cdr.customer_id, 
         (cdr.min_date::DATE) + (g.n - 1) * INTERVAL '1 day' as date_value
  FROM customer_date_range cdr
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, (cdr.max_date - cdr.min_date + 1)::INTEGER) AS g(n)
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.date_value, COALESCE(dn.net_change, 0) as daily_change
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.date_value = dn.txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_value, daily_change,
    SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date_value) as raw_balance
  FROM daily_balances
),
clamped_balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_value, daily_change,
    GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
  FROM cumulative_balances
),
monthly_maxes AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', date_value) as month, customer_id,
    MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
  FROM clamped_balances
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', date_value), customer_id
)
SELECT month, CAST(SUM(max_daily_balance) AS BIGINT) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_maxes
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
